phase_status.note: Partial audit from real-device Android screenshots (2026-05-21). 8 findings logged. Full 30-finding sweep deferred — existing findings are sufficient to begin fix phases.

audit_findings.finding: datetime-local inputs for itinerary starts_at and ends_at render as blank boxes with a single chevron arrow on Android Chrome dark mode. The native format-hint text (mm/dd/yyyy, --:-- --) uses a system-default color that is invisible against bg-transparent on a dark card background. User cannot tell these are time inputs at all. Two mystery chevron boxes sit between Location and the Timezone field with zero affordance.

The 'Add Itinerary Item' card is the second child of `section.grid.lg:grid-cols-[1fr_22rem]`. On mobile the grid is single-column, so the card stacks BELOW all day cards. On a 7-day trip the form is off-screen by ~800-1000px. Users likely never find it on mobile.

Panel nav uses `grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 xl:flex` with 10 panels. At 390px that is 5 rows × ~46px = ~250px of navigation before any content is visible. Screenshot 3 confirms the bottom two rows (Tasks, Documents, Reminders, Imports, Sharing, Details) are a separate visual block the user has to parse.

datetime-local inputs have no visible label, only a placeholder — but datetime-local inputs do not show placeholder text at all. There is zero contextual clue for what starts_at / ends_at represent. Applies identically in the reservation edit form (lines 1441-1450) and all other datetime-local fields.

All add-form cards (reservations line 1827, budget line 1913, packing line 1966, tasks line 2121) are second children of their respective lg:grid-cols-[1fr_Xrem] sections. All stack below their list content on mobile, making all add-entry forms inaccessible without significant scrolling.

The reservation edit form expands inline inside the reservation card (screenshot 2). The flight-details section (airline, flight#, from/to airport, location, address) adds ~8 more fields that stack below the timezone block. On mobile the user must scroll through ~15 fields with the keyboard visible; Save is far below. No section pills or sticky Save button.

Packing list items show Edit + Delete buttons inline at the right edge (screenshot 3 partially visible). On a 390px screen with item label + category + assigned-to info on the left, the Edit/Delete cluster is very small. Misclicking Delete is a real risk. Swipe-to-reveal Delete is the correct pattern.

travel-page, travel-container, travel-panel, travel-hero have no safe-area-inset handling. On iPhones with home indicator the bottom of full-bleed cards will clip behind the indicator. No pt-safe / pb-safe utilities exist.

prior_work_baseline: responsive-ui-uplift (verified 2026-05-05): touch targets >= 44px, 1-col dense forms on mobile, segmented grid trip nav, palette refresh.
scroll-issue (verified 2026-05-06): single document scroll owner on desktop, offcanvas mobile menu.
navigation-uplift (verified 2026-05-07): typed routes, sidebar/mobile-sheet parity, accurate active state.
decisions_locked_in: Full-screen <Sheet> for edit forms on mobile (<sm); inline on desktop (>=sm). Single biggest mobile UX shift.
No bottom-nav bar. Workspace app; existing top header + offcanvas sheet is the right pattern.
Swipe-to-reveal Delete + tap-to-edit on rows for mobile. Inline Edit/Delete buttons stay on desktop.
Safe-area insets (top + bottom + left + right) respected on every full-bleed surface via pt-safe / pb-safe / pb-safe-or-4 utilities plus viewport-fit=cover in the meta tag.
Stay with semantically correct input types (number/email/tel/date/etc); layer inputmode + enterkeyhint + autocomplete on top for keyboard hints. Don't swap to type=text for numerics.
Top progress bar via Inertia's progress plugin (color = theme --primary). Per-section skeletons render only where deferred-prop or measurable wait exists.
Toasts: bottom-center on <sm, top-right on >=sm. 44px close button, 4s auto-dismiss (success) / 6s (error), queue if multiple arrive.
Out of scope for this module: PWA, service worker, offline, native apps/Capacitor, pull-to-refresh, haptics, gesture-based panel switching, design-system swap, new microcopy, a11y-only work.

new_components_planned.name: EditSheet
new_components_planned.purpose: Wraps an edit form; renders full-screen Sheet on <sm, inline on >=sm. Provides sticky Cancel/Save header on mobile.

new_components_planned.name: FormSectionPills
new_components_planned.purpose: Sticky horizontal pill scroller for long forms; jumps to sections via getElementById + scrollIntoView.

new_components_planned.name: SwipeRow
new_components_planned.purpose: Touch-only swipe-left-to-reveal-Delete wrapper. Inert on >=sm. Tap on body invokes primary action (edit).

new_components_planned.name: SkeletonRow
new_components_planned.purpose: Pulsing placeholder block for deferred/loading panels. Use only where audit findings call for it.

new_helpers_planned.name: scrollToFirstError
new_helpers_planned.purpose: Pure function: given an errors object, finds the first matching DOM element via [data-error-target] or [name], scrolls it into view, and focuses it.

css_additions_planned: pt-safe, pb-safe, pl-safe, pr-safe, pb-safe-or-4, pt-safe-or-3 utility classes in resources/css/app.css.
scroll-margin-top rules for deep-link anchors (reservation-{id}, packing-item-{id}, etc.).
active:scale-[0.98] + active:bg-primary/90 additions to travel-button-primary and travel-touch classes.
